sun.mahadasha_effects: Leadership opportunities, government connections, health focus, self-realization journey
sun.parashar_insights: Represents the soul (Atma), self-realization, vitality, and father

remedies.gemstone: Ruby (Manikya) - 3-6 carats, wear on Sunday morning
remedies.charity: Donate wheat, jaggery, red cloth on Sundays to needy

remedies.deity_worship: Lord Surya - Surya Namaskar at sunrise
remedies.lal_kitab: Offer water to Sun at sunrise, help father figures, avoid ego conflicts

moon.mahadasha_effects: Emotional sensitivity, domestic changes, travel, new relationships, mental fluctuations

remedies.gemstone: Pearl (Moti) - 5-7 carats, wear on Monday morning
remedies.charity: Donate white items, milk, rice on Mondays
remedies.fasting: Monday - avoid salt, eat white foods
remedies.lal_kitab: Keep silver with you, serve mother, drink water from silver vessel

mars.mahadasha_effects: Energy boost, property dealings, conflicts, surgery, assertion of power
mars.parashar_insights: Represents courage, land, property, siblings, and energy

mantras: Om Kram Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namaha

remedies.fasting: Tuesday - eat simple food, avoid meat
remedies.lal_kitab: Keep red items, serve brothers, avoid conflicts, donate sweets at temples

mercury.mahadasha_effects: Business growth, education, communication, short travels, intellectual pursuits

remedies.deity_worship: Lord Hanuman, Lord Shiva, Shani Dev
remedies.lal_kitab: Serve crows, feed dogs, donate mustard oil, respect servants and elderly

1.name: Tanu Bhava (Lagna)
1.signifies: Self, body, personality, overall health, appearance
1.psychological_impact: Self-image, confidence, how you present to world

2.name: Dhana Bhava
2.signifies: Wealth, family, speech, food, early childhood

3.name: Sahaj Bhava
3.signifies: Courage, siblings, short travels, communication, skills

4.name: Sukha Bhava
4.signifies: Mother, home, emotions, inner peace, vehicles, land

5.name: Putra Bhava
5.signifies: Intelligence, creativity, children, romance, past life merit

6.name: Ripu/Roga Bhava
6.signifies: Enemies, disease, debts, service, daily work
6.psychological_impact: Stress from enemies, health anxiety, work pressure

8.name: Ayu Bhava
8.signifies: Longevity, transformation, occult, sudden events, inheritance
8.psychological_impact: Fear of death, transformation anxiety, mysteries

9.name: Dharma Bhava
9.signifies: Dharma, father, guru, fortune, long travels, higher learning

11.name: Labha Bhava
11.signifies: Gains, friends, desires, elder siblings, networks

12.name: Vyaya Bhava
12.signifies: Losses, expenses, foreign lands, spirituality, isolation, moksha
12.psychological_impact: Anxiety from losses, spiritual seeking, isolation

yogas_mental_health.name: Amavasya Dosha
yogas_mental_health.effect: Mental confusion, emotional turmoil, identity issues
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Chandra mantra 108 times daily, donate white items on Mondays

yogas_mental_health.name: Kemadruma Yoga
yogas_mental_health.condition: Moon alone in a house with no planets in adjacent houses (2nd and 12th from Moon)
yogas_mental_health.effect: Anxiety, poverty mentality, emotional isolation, mental instability
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Pearl gemstone, Moon worship, serve mother, donate milk

yogas_mental_health.name: Grahan Yoga (Eclipse Yoga)
yogas_mental_health.effect: Mental affliction, confusion, addictions, health issues
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Prayers during eclipses, donate during eclipse, mantra of afflicted planet

yogas_mental_health.name: Pitra Dosha
yogas_mental_health.condition: Sun afflicted by Rahu, Ketu, or malefics in 9th house issues
yogas_mental_health.effect: Ancestral curses, father issues, lack of direction, depression
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Perform Shraddha rituals, help fathers, donate on Sundays, Pitru Tarpan

yogas_mental_health.name: Shakata Yoga
yogas_mental_health.effect: Mental ups and downs, financial fluctuations, pessimism
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Jupiter remedies, worship Lord Vishnu, donate yellow items on Thursdays

yogas_mental_health.name: Mental Affliction Yoga
yogas_mental_health.condition: Moon afflicted by Saturn, Rahu, or Mars in 1st, 4th, 5th houses
yogas_mental_health.effect: Mental disorders, anxiety, depression, emotional instability
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Moon remedies, mental health support, meditation, spiritual practices

yogas_mental_health.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
yogas_mental_health.effect: Great mental strength, wisdom, optimistic outlook, and ability to overcome depression.

yogas_mental_health.name: Saraswati Yoga
yogas_mental_health.condition: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury in 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, or 10 houses
yogas_mental_health.effect: High artistic intelligence, creativity, and balanced mental approach.
yogas_mental_health.remedy: Worship Goddess Saraswati, maintain daily learning.

yogas_mental_health.name: Amala Yoga
yogas_mental_health.condition: Benefics (Jupiter/Venus/Mercury) in 10th house from Moon or Lagna
yogas_mental_health.effect: Purity of character, professional integrity, and mental peace through career success.
